doc: RUN! RUN! RUN! (mode $21, state table 09:5FE7): (1) a race played with A every 2nd frame; on the first frame of state 07 (the handler with the race-end test, 09:63B4) the three runner positions are poked past the finish line ($D001:$D000 := $1590, $D00F:$D00E and $D018:$D017 := $1500) together with the place counter $D047 := $FF and the three places $D00D / $D016 / $D01F := 0: the placement of runner 0 (09:6AF0-6AFC) wraps the counter to 0 and gives runner 0 the place 0, runners 1 and 2 make it 2, and the race-end test (09:63E1) finds runner 0 unplaced: 09:63FE; (2) after the race the state number $D5CF is poked to 9 (09:6435: sets state 3) and to $0D (09:66BB: a lone ret), states no code ever selects
